svg.title: Good choices need good solutions
svg.desc: All fourteen configurations across four optimization tasks. A direct, C heuristic proposals. Lower gaps are better. Each task has its own axis; dashed bars and bracketed counts mark partial coverage.

g.text: Mean reference gap on completed graphs / Lower is better / Ten graphs scheduled per mode
absolute Q gap | independent task scale
Partial subsets are not directly rankable against full coverage. Forced-only completions do not establish model support.
* Astra uses reasoning; GPT-5.4 uses none. Modularity uses certified references; MaxCut uses historical BKS.
